sources.name: Kiranico (MH Rise: Sunbreak)
sources.notes: Database ver. 16.0.0. Rise lists hitzones, not stars. Stars = best elemental hitzone over all parts in the normal state: >=25 3 stars, 20-24 2, 10-19 1, <10 0 (calibrated on World Rathalos, whose official notes give dragon 30=3, thunder 20=2, water/ice 15=1, fire 0=X).
